clans.name: Founding fossils
clans.story: The first upload: standalone 2024–25 scripts (phiworld2.py, crystal_kingdom.py, knotiverse, mirror.py, live.py, bit-theory, SpaceScreensaver.py, nphard2.py, palmers_rope.py …) re-housed as nodes. Most of the lab's later vocabulary — fields, attractors, crystals, solitons, “phi” — is already present here as carried-in fossils.

clans.name: Plumbing & instruments of the host
clans.story: Sources, adapters, displays and small math. Boring, and the most-used part of the lab: ConstantSignal, MediaSource, Display, VectorSplitter, ImageToVector. Every interesting graph is held together by these.

clans.name: IHT & the quantum metaphor
clans.story: Qubits, wavefunctions, decoherence, entanglement “detectors”, mode-address algebra and the IHT (Informational/holographic theory) papers. Classical arrays dressed in quantum words — useful as a vocabulary mine, not as physics.

clans.name: Fractal, moiré & gauge toys
clans.story: Mandelbrot/Julia, moiré fields, box counting, distance fields, “depth from mathematics”, SU(2)/SU(3) colour rotations, circulator swarms and globes. Mostly visual instruments; the webcam-art workflows of mid-November live here.

clans.name: Latent-space machines
clans.story: PCA, real VAEs, latent annealers, explorers and encoders. The first time the lab learned something from data rather than only simulating.

clans.name: The W-matrix self
clans.story: Models of a mind as a self-modifying W matrix: Human Attractor, the damaged visual cortex (written from Antti's own after-image experience), fast/slow P-KAS encoders, qualia and free-will nodes, retrocausal buffers, Free-Energy observers, Hebbian learners.

clans.name: EEG eigenmodes → growing cortex
clans.story: EEG band powers read as cortical eigenmodes that drive 3-D growth, folding and turbulence; the 55-D “Bessel” address; retinotopic Schwartz maps. The first big EEG→geometry clan.

clans.name: Cabbage suite & the Genesis System
clans.story: A body / observer / scanner triangle that grows an “organism” toward a target image through a 55-dimensional DNA; ecosystems of Genesis loops; tissue architects. The name “cabbage” resurfaces in 2026 (CabbageFarm, CabbageFarmSihti).

clans.name: Holography & complex spectra
clans.story: 2-D FFT as “hologram”, complex-number ports, interference, EEG phase interferometers (Phi-Hologram), beamformers, carrier/signal separation and phase “cryptography”. The purple complex_spectrum port is this clan's legacy.

clans.name: Strange loops, scars & avalanches
clans.story: Fields that listen to their own eigenfrequencies: tension builds, avalanches flip cells, scars insulate. Self-Consistent Resonance (“the star”), the Wednesday Loop, Crystal Cave, excitable media, attractor swarms and cluster mutations.

clans.name: Artificial life & evolution
clans.story: Organisms, protocells, antenna-shaped DNA, shape evolution and arms races, epicycle worlds and gardens. Includes the lab's own best bug story: evolution that optimised a knob that did nothing.

clans.name: EEG tokens & the Ma framework
clans.story: EEG cut into wavelet tokens with theta as a clock, “biological attention” over regions, and a week of Yi Ma's parsimony / rate-reduction / closed-loop transcription vocabulary.

clans.name: Real cortical geometry
clans.story: The turn to actual anatomy: fsaverage mesh Laplacian eigenmodes, MNE source localisation, mode phase dynamics, folded cortical sheets, theta–beta gating observatories and multi-module cortical learning.

clans.name: The crystal line
clans.story: EEG “crystallises” a lattice by STDP; the frozen lattice becomes a living entity, then a chip with frontal input pins and posterior output pins, then something to probe with chirps and impulses. Grows into NeuroCrystals, Barabási surface tension and the Lazarus resurrection engine.

clans.name: Phi & golden-ratio vision
clans.story: Golden-angle sampling of webcams, φ-ratio verifiers for EEG, ring zooms, Φ-dwell macroscopes and Φ-mandalas. Contains the earliest “Sigh” (FFT band-pass) in the record.

clans.name: Feedback computers & the ECG accident
clans.story: Loops that compute by relaxing: an analog Laplace solver, attention latches, the Homeostatic Coupler — and on 14 Feb 2026 the 5-node checkerboard loop whose 59-step pulse became the origin story of the geometric neuron.

clans.name: Deerskin & the geometric neuron
clans.story: The lab returns as an instrument for the line it started: chronotopic radar, geometric-neuron ODEs, Hankel/Takens dendrites, skew-island arrow readers, resonator axon/soma/synapse/septum (v18–v19), the calibrated wave field, and the Moebius loop memory.

clans.name: Metabolism, islands & the mycelial cortex
clans.story: Four days that wired a thermodynamic cognition loop: skew flux as an arrow of time, ATP as fatigue, Hopfield recall sharpened by energy, island archival on exhaustion, then the Mycelial Cortex — geometric-neuron populations that grow nodes and talk across machines by tokens.
